steps.eval: window.__hangHidden = (index) => { const line = document.querySelectorAll('.cm-line')[index]; const walker = document.createTreeWalker(line, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); const rects = []; for (let n = walker.nextNode(); n; n = walker.nextNode()) { for (let i = 0; i < n.length; i++) { const r = document.createRange(); r.setStart(n, i); r.setEnd(n, i + 1); const b = r.getClientRects()[0]; if (b) rects.push({ ch: n.data[i], left: b.left, top: b.top }); } } const start = rects.findIndex((r) => r.ch === '朝'); const first = rects[start]; const lefts = []; let last = first.top; for (const r of rects.slice(start)) { if (r.top > last + 5) { lefts.push(r.left); last = r.top; } } return { firstLeft: first.left, wrappedLefts: lefts, contentLeft: line.getBoundingClientRect().left }; }; true

expect.eval: (() => { const e = window.__hangHidden(0); return e.wrappedLefts.length >= 1 && e.wrappedLefts.every((l) => Math.abs(l - e.firstLeft) <= 2) && e.firstLeft - e.contentLeft > 5; })()
